name: Nitida Tables – Responsive, Mobile-Friendly Table Builder
author: Nitida

sections.description:
Most table plugins make you scroll sideways on a phone. Nitida Tables turns every row into a readable card on small screens, so visitors see the whole row at once: the first column becomes the card title and every other cell is shown with its column name.

It is fast, too. There is no jQuery and no big data-table library on your pages: the front end is one small stylesheet and one small script, under 8 KB together when compressed.

Responsive tables that stay readable on phones

  • Mobile-first cards. Rows become cards when the screen or the content column is narrow (it uses a container query, so tables in sidebars and narrow columns work as well).
  • Instant search and sorting. Search appears on longer tables; headers sort text, numbers and dates (31.12.2026, 2026-12-31, 12/31/2026 and month names).
  • Fits your theme. Uses your theme’s primary color automatically, supports dark mode (system setting or your theme’s dark-mode class), right-to-left languages and screen readers.
  • Styles with a live preview. Clean, striped, bordered or minimal; comfortable or compact; subtle or colored header; corner radius; when rows become cards. Every change shows in a live desktop and phone preview before you save.

A table builder that works like a spreadsheet

  • Spreadsheet-style editor. Type, press Tab and Enter, paste straight from Excel or Google Sheets, insert, move, hide and delete rows and columns, add links, undo and redo.
  • Paste a table, get the same table. Copy a table from any web page, Excel, Google Sheets or Word and paste it: rows, columns, links, bold and italic text and line breaks come through 1:1.
  • Formulas. Start a cell with = to calculate: =SUM(B2:B10), =B2*C2, =IF(D2>100,"Yes","No"). Cell addresses work like a spreadsheet (A1 is the first cell of the header row), and functions include SUM, AVERAGE, MIN, MAX, COUNT, ROUND, IF and FIXED.
  • Merged cells. Select cells and choose Merge cells. On phones the merged value shows in every card it covers. Tables moved from TablePress keep their merged cells and formulas.
  • Column types. Auto-detected or set by hand: text, number, date, link, or a highlighted key value that is easy to copy.
  • Images and buttons. Pick images from the Media Library for product lists, team pages and catalogs. On phones the image sits at the top of each card. Button columns turn links into clear buttons, for example Buy, Download or Book.
  • Choose what shows on phones. Show a column everywhere, only in the wide table or only in the phone cards, so wide tables stay short and readable on small screens.
  • Highlight the first row. Mark the newest item with a small “Latest” badge.
  • Live preview. See the desktop and the phone layout before you save.
  • Revisions. Every save is kept; restore any earlier version in one click.
  • Safe with automation. If a table changes while you are editing it (another editor, an import, an API update), Nitida Tables does not overwrite it silently.

Templates for pricing tables, schedules, specs and more

Start from one of 34 ready-made tables: pricing plans, a comparison of two options, product specs, an event schedule, a class timetable, opening hours, a restaurant menu, shipping rates, a size chart, league standings, an FAQ, a contact directory, pros and cons, a product comparison with top picks, property listings, review scores, an employee directory, store locations, match fixtures, a transit timetable, a glossary and more. Replace the sample rows with yours or paste them from Excel. See every template as a live table on getnitida.com.

Import from Excel, CSV and other table plugins

  • Import and export. CSV, TSV, Excel (.xlsx), HTML and JSON in; CSV and JSON out.
  • Migration assistant. Nitida Tables finds tables made with TablePress, Ninja Tables, wpDataTables and Data Tables Generator by Supsystic, shows where each one is used and what carries over, and copies them. Turn on “Keep old shortcodes working” and existing posts show the Nitida copies without edits. The original tables are never changed, so you can switch back at any time.
  • Convert WordPress table blocks. Select a table block in the editor and click Convert to Nitida Table: the cells carry over and the table becomes searchable, sortable and readable on phones. The migration assistant lists the posts that still have table blocks.
  • Backup and restore. Download all tables as one JSON file and restore them on any site.

Works where you build your pages

  • Block, Elementor widget and shortcode. Use the Nitida Table block, the Nitida Table widget in Elementor, or [nitida_table id="1"].
  • Ready for translation. Every text in the plugin and its scripts can be translated on translate.wordpress.org.
  • Optimization friendly. Optional inline CSS mode for sites that strip unused plugin CSS.

Need more? Nitida Tables Pro

The free plugin is complete on its own. Nitida Tables Pro is a separate add-on for sites that need more: tables that update themselves from Google Sheets, CSV or JSON, filters and pagination for large tables, a comparison layout for pricing plans and products, charts, and CSV or Excel downloads for visitors. Details are on getnitida.com.

Made by Nitida

Documentation, live examples and the separate Nitida Tables Pro add-on are on getnitida.com.

Privacy

Nitida Tables does not track visitors, does not set cookies and makes no external requests.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate the plugin. A short guide on the Nitida Tables screen walks you through the first steps.
  2. Go to Nitida Tables > Add new, or Nitida Tables > Import to bring in a CSV, Excel, HTML or JSON file (or your TablePress tables).
  3. Add the Nitida Table block to a post or page, or paste the shortcode shown in the table list.
sections.faq:
Can I make pricing tables and comparison tables?

Yes. Under Nitida Tables > Add new, start from the “Pricing plans” or “Compare two options” template. On phones each row becomes a card. Nitida Tables Pro adds a comparison layout: the plan you recommend stands out, Yes and No become icons, and phones show one plan at a time.

Can I move from Ninja Tables, wpDataTables or Data Tables Generator?

Yes. Open Nitida Tables > From other plugins. Nitida Tables lists every table those plugins stored, where each one is used, and what does not carry over (for example charts or conditional formatting). Copy the tables, then turn on “Keep old shortcodes working”: posts that use [ninja_tables id=…], [wpdatatable id=…], [supsystic-tables id=…] or the plugins’ blocks show the Nitida copies. Tables fed from Google Sheets, files or SQL queries are copied once as they are now.

Will my TablePress tables keep working?

Yes. Import them under Nitida Tables > Import. The table numbers stay the same, so after you enable “Also handle [table id=N] shortcodes” in the settings, your existing posts show the Nitida Tables version without any edits. TablePress itself is not changed, so you can switch back at any time.

Can I convert the table blocks already in my posts?

Yes. Open the post, select the table block and click Convert to Nitida Table in the block toolbar. The cells, the header row and links carry over, and you can undo it right away. Nitida Tables > From other plugins lists the posts and pages that still have table blocks. If you would rather not change your posts, Nitida Tables Pro shows the existing table blocks as cards on phones as they are.

When do rows turn into cards?

When the table is narrower than 600 pixels, or the screen is narrower than 720 pixels.

Can I change the colors?

Nitida Tables uses your theme’s primary color by default. Set another color (or a CSS variable such as var(--brand)) under Nitida Tables > Settings. All colors are CSS custom properties (--tt-accent, --tt-border, --tt-bg and more) that your theme can override.

My optimization plugin removes the table styles.

Switch Nitida Tables > Settings > Advanced > Performance to “Inline”.

Can developers update tables from code?

Yes: nitida_tables_get( $id ), nitida_tables_save( $id, $patch, $expected_modified ), nitida_tables_create() and the nitida_tables_saved action. Passing $expected_modified makes the update refuse to overwrite a newer version.

Who can edit tables?

Editors and administrators by default (the publish_pages capability). Change it with the nitida_tables_capability filter. Only administrators can change the settings.

What happens to my tables if I delete the plugin?

They stay in your database unless you enable “Delete all tables when the plugin is deleted” in the settings.
sections.changelog:
1.2.0

  • New: image columns. Insert images from the Media Library or paste an image address. Images load lazily, Media Library images get the right size for each screen, and on phones the image sits at the top of each card. Their alt text is searchable.
  • New: button columns. Links show as buttons; a bare address gets the column name as its label.
  • New: “Show on” for every column: everywhere, only in the wide table, or only in the phone cards. Search still covers every column.
  • New: convert a WordPress table block into a Nitida table with one click in the block editor. The migration assistant lists the posts and pages that still have table blocks.
  • New: a short getting started guide on the Nitida Tables screen. It ticks off each step by itself and can be hidden.
  • New: 16 more templates, 34 in all: service price list, membership tiers, ticket prices, pros and cons, course curriculum, glossary, changelog by type, employee directory, store locations, match fixtures and results, transit timetable, holiday and closure calendar, product comparison and top picks, property listings, review scores and exchange rates.
  • Change: columns where almost every cell is an image are now detected as image columns. On phones that image moves to the top of the card, and these columns are not sortable.

1.1.1

  • New: a “Sort by” menu on phones. When a table shows as cards, visitors can still sort it by any column.
  • Improved: search ignores accents and letter variants (cafe finds café, istanbul finds İstanbul, strasse finds Straße) and finds numbers with or without thousands separators.
  • Improved: sorting understands prices and percentages ($1,299, 1.299,00 €, 45%) and keeps empty cells last.
  • Improved: links, sort arrows and the “Clear search” button are easier to read on dark backgrounds; the green highlight badge has more contrast.
  • Improved: the editor is much faster on large tables when you add rows or paste.
  • Improved: arrow keys move between cells at the edge of the text, Esc leaves the grid, and screen readers hear the column name with each cell.
  • Improved: when saving fails you can download your draft as a CSV file, and a file over the server’s upload limit says so.
  • Fixed: hidden table headers in card view no longer take keyboard focus.
  • Change: the template list shows only templates this plugin can create. Templates that use Pro features are part of Nitida Tables Pro.

1.1.0

  • New: formulas. Start a cell with = to calculate, for example =SUM(B2:B10), =B2*C2 or =IF(D2>100,”Yes”,”No”). Cell addresses work like a spreadsheet: A1 is the first cell of the header row. Functions: SUM, AVERAGE, MIN, MAX, COUNT, COUNTA, PRODUCT, MEDIAN, ROUND, ROUNDUP, ROUNDDOWN, INT, ABS, SQRT, POWER, MOD, PI, IF, AND, OR, NOT, IFERROR, CONCAT, FIXED, ROW and COLUMN. Start a cell with ‘= to show the text as it is.
  • New: merged cells. Select cells in the editor and choose Merge cells, or Unmerge to split them again. On phones the merged value shows in every card it covers. Tables with merged rows turn off sorting and search, because those would split the merged rows.
  • New: tables moved from TablePress keep their merged cells and formulas; HTML imports keep merged cells.
  • Change: editor row numbers start at 1 for the first row, like a spreadsheet, so they match formula addresses.

1.0.1

  • Fix: a table shown more than once on a page now gets unique HTML ids (also with the row cache), so anchors and aria-controls stay valid.
  • Fix: on dark themes the table no longer shows light text on its white surface; the minimal style follows the theme colors.
  • Fix: long column labels in the phone card view wrap instead of overlapping the next row.
  • Fix: table header text now has enough contrast (WCAG AA).
  • Fix: the upload size message now matches the real limit (5 MB).

1.0.0

  • First release of Nitida Tables.
